author: ETA PRIME
description:
I found the cheapest x86 PC gaming handheld on Facebook Marketplace for only $99! When the Anbernic Win600 launched in 2022 for $375, it was hard to recommend. But for under $100? It might just be the ultimate budget machine for indie games and older AAA titles.

In this video, we tear down the Win600, ditch the stock 8GB of RAM for a 16GB DDR4 stick, and replace Windows 10 with Bazzite OS to give it that true console-like SteamOS experience. We also dive into the BIOS to dedicate 7GB of VRAM and use a quick terminal command to force the memory to run at its full 3200 MT/s
